milestones.title: Verify component c01 at grouping level 1
Verify component c02 at grouping level 1

S1.instruction: Process the currently published c01 source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, and lowercase kind and status. Retain only records with status ok, nonempty record_id and client, kind sale or refund, quantity matching ASCII [0-9]{1,2} and integer 1..50, and unit_price matching ASCII [0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2} with a literal decimal point. Skip invalid records; among valid records retain only the first occurrence of each normalized record_id. Convert unit_price exactly to integer cents; compute quantity times unit cents, positive for sale and negative for refund. Preserve normalized client, kind, quantity, record_id, unit_cents, and net_cents. Sort retained rows lexically by record_id.

S2.instruction: Using the currently published c01_rows, group retained rows by client in lexical order. For each client, output its retained-record count and sum of net_cents as an exact integer. Do not count quantities as records or use floating-point arithmetic.

S3.instruction: Using the current c01_aggregates, render exactly: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand amount with exactly two decimal places>. Convert integer cents to decimal amounts exactly, use single spaces, include a minus sign only for negative amounts, and do not add a trailing newline.

S4.instruction: Inspect the current c01 environment revision and verify that c01_report passes its published requirements. Provide a certification artifact with environment_revision equal to that current revision and checked_gates exactly ["c01_report"], in that order. Do not certify if the referenced gate does not pass.

S5.instruction: Process the currently published c02 source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, and lowercase kind and status. A record is valid only if status is exactly ok, normalized record_id and client are nonempty, kind is sale or refund, quantity consists solely of 1–2 ASCII digits and has integer value 1..50, and unit_price matches the full ASCII pattern [0-9]{1,5}\.[0-9]{2} (the period is literal). Skip invalid records before deduplication, so an invalid record does not reserve its ID. For valid records, retain only the first occurrence of each normalized record_id. Convert unit_price exactly to integer cents without floating point; multiply by quantity and negate the result for refunds. Emit each retained row with normalized client, kind, quantity, record_id, integer unit_cents, and signed integer net_cents. Sort output rows lexically by record_id.

S6.instruction: Using the currently published c02_rows, group retained rows by client in lexical order. For each client, output its retained-record count and sum of net_cents as an exact integer. Do not count quantities as records or use floating-point arithmetic.

S7.instruction: Using the current c02_aggregates, render exactly: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand amount with exactly two decimal places>. Convert integer cents to decimal amounts exactly, use single spaces, include a minus sign only for negative amounts, and do not add a trailing newline.

S8.instruction: Inspect the current c02 environment revision and verify that c02_report passes its published requirements. Provide a certification artifact with environment_revision equal to that current revision and checked_gates exactly ["c02_report"], in that order. Do not certify if the referenced gate does not pass.
